shots.zh: AI 正在从聊天，走向真正帮企业干活。
shots.en: AI is moving beyond chat — into doing real work for your business.

shots.zh: 它读取你的业务数据，判断风险，还能动手创建记录、推进流程。
shots.en: It reads your business data, spots risks, and takes action — creating records, moving processes forward.

shots.zh: 但是——这样的 AI，你敢放心交给它吗？
shots.en: But an AI like this — would you trust it with your business?

shots.zh: 它会不会碰不该碰的数据？会不会没有批准就乱写？出了问题，我们查得清、撤得回吗？
shots.en: Could it touch data it shouldn't? Write without approval? If something goes wrong, can we trace it and undo it?

shots.zh: KeelBase 给出的答案，是一个业务安全的 AI 运行时。
shots.en: KeelBase answers with a business-safe AI runtime.

shots.zh: 上面是 AI 助手，下面是你的业务系统——CRM、ERP、OA。KeelBase 在中间，守住每一道边界。
shots.en: AI assistants on top. Your systems below — CRM, ERP, OA. KeelBase sits between them, guarding every boundary.

shots.zh: 身份、权限、人工确认、审计、撤销——每一步都有规则，每一次都有记录。
shots.en: Identity, permissions, human confirmation, audit, revocation — every step has rules, every action leaves a record.

shots.zh: 一句话：AI 可以干活，但只在它被允许的范围内。
shots.en: In short: AI can act — but only within the boundaries you set.

shots.zh: 您那些跑了十年的 Java 系统、老 CRM——不用重写。把接口交给 KeelBase，它们立刻变成受管控的 AI 工具：查数据的自动执行，改数据的先请您批准。
shots.en: Your ten-year-old Java systems, your legacy CRM — no rewrite needed. Hand their APIs to KeelBase, and they instantly become governed AI tools: reads run automatically, writes ask for your approval.

shots.zh: 路径就是这样：您的 Java 系统和现有接口，经过 KeelBase 治理层，变成 AI 能安全调用的工具——读操作自动执行，写操作必须批准，全程审计、可撤销。
shots.en: Here is the path: your Java systems and existing APIs pass through KeelBase governance and become AI tools it can safely call — reads run automatically, writes require approval, fully audited and revocable.

shots.zh: 存量系统，焕发新的 AI 能力。核心代码一行不改。
shots.en: Legacy systems gain new AI capabilities. Not a single line of core code changes.

shots.zh: 比如，问 AI 哪些客户最值得跟进。它查的是真实业务数据——瀚宇制造，逾期两百八十万，风险最高，建议立即催收。
shots.en: Ask AI which customers deserve attention. It reads real business data — HanYu Manufacturing, 2.8 million overdue, highest risk, worth an immediate call.

shots.zh: 当 AI 要动手创建任务，它会先停下来，把要做什么讲清楚，请您批准。您点头，它才执行——每一步都留痕、可追溯。
shots.en: When AI wants to create a task, it pauses, explains what it will do, and asks for your approval. Only after you approve does it execute — every step traced and auditable.

shots.zh: 项目管理也是一样。AI 帮你预判哪些项目有延期风险，提前介入，而不是事后救火。
shots.en: Project management works the same way. AI flags at-risk projects early, so you intervene before delays snowball.

shots.zh: 审批流自动交给 AI 预审：小额合规的直接通过，大额敏感的转人工复核。又快，又守得住。
shots.en: Approvals get AI pre-audit: small compliant requests pass automatically, large or sensitive ones route to human review. Fast, yet still guarded.

shots.zh: 不管接的是哪家的 AI 助手，不管对接什么业务系统——都只走这一个信任层。
shots.en: Whatever AI assistant you use, whatever systems you connect — it all flows through this one trust layer.

shots.zh: 这不是又一个聊天机器人框架。这是企业 AI 的信任底座。
shots.en: This is not another chatbot framework. It is the trust foundation for enterprise AI.

shots.zh: 权限、工具、审计——安全不是嘴上说说，是可验证、经得起检查的。
shots.en: Access, tools, audit — security here is not a promise. It is verifiable and inspectable.

shots.zh: 安全不是靠提示词哄出来的，是运行时强制执行出来的。
shots.en: Security is not enforced by prompts. It is enforced at runtime, structurally.

shots.zh: 每一次 AI 操作，都进入一条防篡改的审计链。系统跑得怎么样，一屏看尽。
shots.en: Every AI action lands in a tamper-proof audit chain. How the system is running — one glance tells you.

shots.zh: 治理看板一屏掌握：AI 助手、策略、风险、审计、审批。整个平台的状况清清楚楚。
shots.en: A governance dashboard shows it all at a glance: assistants, policies, risk, audit, approvals. Full visibility across the platform.

shots.zh: 要建新业务模块？用一句话描述需求，一条命令，直接生成可用的业务代码。
shots.en: Need a new business module? Describe it in one sentence, run one command, and get working business code.

shots.zh: 生成的是您自己的源代码——看得懂、改得动、完全可控。
shots.en: What you get is your own source code — readable, editable, fully under your control.

shots.zh: 从需求描述，到可运行的系统。
shots.en: From a description to a running system.

shots.zh: 数据敏感？那就私有化部署。全部数据留在您自己的机房里，一步不出域。
shots.en: Data sensitive? Deploy privately. All data stays inside your own infrastructure — never leaves your domain.

shots.zh: 容器、离线、本地部署——数据主权，完全握在自己手里。
shots.en: Containers, offline, on-premise — data sovereignty stays entirely in your hands.

shots.zh: 构建、运行、信任、私有部署。这就是 KeelBase 的完整闭环。
shots.en: Build, run, trust, private deployment. This is the complete KeelBase loop.

shots.zh: 开源，面向业务安全。AI 能干活，但只在您允许的边界内。
shots.en: Open source, built for business safety. AI can act — but only within the boundaries you allow.
